description: This file provides a partial implementation of the mbstring (multibyte string) extension in PHP, including various encoding, case conversion, and string manipulation functions, within the namespace Symfony\Polyfill\Mbstring.

classes.name: Symfony\Polyfill\Mbstring\Mbstring
classes.description: A PHP class that implements various multibyte string functions, mimicking the mbstring extension, with support for encoding conversions, case transformations, and other string manipulations.

methods.name: mb_convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts the encoding of a string or array of strings from one encoding to another.

methods.name: mb_detect_encoding
methods.description: Detects the character encoding of a given string based on a list of possible encodings.

methods.name: mb_strlen
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in a string, accounting for multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a string in a given string.

methods.name: mb_substr
methods.description: Returns a portion of a string.

methods.name: mb_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts all alphabetic characters in a string to uppercase.

methods.name: mb_strtolower
methods.description: Converts all alphabetic characters in a string to lowercase.

methods.name: mb_substr_count
methods.description: Counts the number of times a substring occurs within a string.

methods.name: mb_convert_case
methods.description: Performs case folding on a string, such as uppercasing, lowercasing, or title case.

methods.name: mb_chr
methods.description: Returns a Unicode character from a code point.

methods.name: mb_ord
methods.description: Returns the Unicode code point of a given character.

methods.name: mb_internal_encoding
methods.description: Sets or gets the internal character encoding.

methods.name: mb_encoding_aliases
methods.description: Returns an array of encoding aliases for a given encoding.

methods.name: mb_check_encoding
methods.description: Checks if a string or array of strings are valid for a specified encoding.

methods.name: mb_detect_order
methods.description: Sets or gets the character encoding detection order.

methods.name: mb_list_encodings
methods.description: Returns a list of all available encodings.

methods.name: mb_http_input
methods.description: Detects the character encoding of HTTP input. (Stub implementation returning false)

methods.name: mb_http_output
methods.description: Get or set the HTTP output character encoding.

methods.name: mb_get_info
methods.description: Returns information about the mbstring settings and environment.

methods.name: mb_output_handler
methods.description: Processes output buffer encoding (stub implementation returning contents unchanged).

methods.name: mb_str_split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array of characters or chunks.

methods.name: mb_strrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring in a string.

methods.name: mb_stristr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a string within another, case-insensitive, and returns the part before or after.

methods.name: mb_strrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: mb_strrichr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: mb_strripos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring, case-insensitive.

methods.name: mb_strstr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a string within another.

methods.name: mb_strwidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string.

methods.name: mb_ucfirst
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to uppercase.

methods.name: mb_lcfirst
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to lowercase.

methods.name: mb_trim
methods.description: Strips whitespace or other characters from the beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: mb_ltrim
methods.description: Strips whitespace or other characters from the beginning of a string.

methods.name: mb_rtrim
methods.description: Strips whitespace or other characters from the end of a string.
